profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Desktop and Server Engineer, focusing on process automation and integration.  Advanced scripting skills, with extensive experience with PowerShell, VBScript, WinBatch, and Perl.  High level of expertise in product integration, to provide fully automated solutions for process that involve several different products and technologies.

Specialties: Workstation and Server Deployments, Complex IT Process Automation, Scripting

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
I left the workforce to finish my education.  I have worked as an RA in the Computer Science department for the past three years, focusing on formal verification of software.

Notable Projects
   •	Extended software verification tool SMACK to support verification of pthread programs
   •	Designed and implemented an Eclipse plugin to visualize error traces for SMACK
   •	Built distributed framework and web interface for concurrently benchmarking SMACK
   •	Helped prepare SMACK for participation in SVCOMP, a verification competition

Publications
   •	M. Carter, S. He, J. Whitaker, Z. Rakamarić, and M. Emmi.  SMACK Software Verification Toolchain.  In Proc. of the 2016 International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE '16) (To appear)
   •	M. Carter, P. Deligiannis, A. Donaldson, M. Emmi, S. He, A. Lal, S. Qadeer, Z. Rakamarić, and J. Whitaker. SMACK+Corral: A modular verifier (competition contribution). In Proc. TACAS. Springer, 2016. (To appear)
   •	A. Haran, M. Carter, M. Emmi, A. Lal, S. Qadeer, and Z. Rakamarić. SMACK+Corral: A modular verifier (competition contribution). In Proc. TACAS. Springer, 2015.

positions.title: Head of IT Department
positions.description:
Transitioned from consulting with Parallel HR through ZDeploy to a full time position as Head IT Manager responsible for all technology within the organization.   I grew the infrastructure from a single server and 5 workstations at a single location into a global infrastructure with 5 locations, 5 physical servers, 20 virtual servers, and 50 workstations.

VMware Infrastructure
   •	Designed and deployed a multi-datacenter, clustered VMware vCenter 3.5 implementation, with shared storage via NetApp over NFS.  Upgraded to 4.1 then 5.1.

Microsoft Exchange
   •	Designed, implemented and migrated to Microsoft Exchange 2010 environment
   •	Exchange designed with multi-site DAG, and redundant client access and transport servers.  Implemented Exchange archiving to meet storage and performance needs

Network Infrastructure
   •	Designed edge network, with intra-site and remote access communication facilitated by Cisco ASA 5505s.  Configured dual WAN links with automatic failover.
   •	Core network strengthened through implementation of additional subnets, VLANs, and redundant domain controllers, DNS, DHCP, and WINS servers.

Backup and Disaster Recovery
   •	Created primary and backup datacenters using VMware Infrastructure, where critical services were duplicated and on standby in backup datacenter
   •	Designed backup solution using DFRS, VMware & NetApp snapshots, and some custom scripts for nightly replication of non-mission critical database.

Additional Accomplishments
   •	Strengthened public DNS through configuration of secondary public DNS server.
   •	Deployed MS SharePoint, OTRS ticketing, Nagios network monitoring, Sophos Anti-virus
